configuration.background_force_rule: unchanged parent force: minus native vertical viscous stencil of prescribed UL=(waves-alpha)*Sref*exp(2kz)+uoffset, with ORIGINAL background gradient boundary fluxes

initial_jet.matching_rule: Nearest same-sign extremum within the fixed initial depth interval; widths below four cells are flagged unresolved; positional match does not establish material identity

runs.qualification: Matched retention or erosion of a pre-existing generated jet; one realization does not establish a universal regime boundary or autonomous closure
